examples.arabic: العيلة كلها كانت متجمعة علشان تاكل اكلة حلوة اوي
examples.english: The whole family was gathered to eat a very delicious meal.
examples.transliteration: El 3ela kolaha kanet metgamme3a 3alashan takol akla 7elwa awi

examples.arabic: انا فكرت في اكلة حلوة ومشروبات ساقعة بس فين بقى
examples.english: I thought about a nice meal and cold drinks, but where?
examples.transliteration: Ana fikkart fi `akla helwa we mashroubaat sa'`a bas fein ba'a.

examples.arabic: هو قال فكرة كويسة اوي انا كنت لسه بفكر في اكله حلوة الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير
examples.english: He said, "That's a very good idea! I was just thinking about a nice meal. The good weather in spring is short."
examples.transliteration: Howa 'aal fekra kwayyisa awi ana kunt lessa bafakkar fi akla Helwa el-gaww el-kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer.

examples.arabic: وهفكر في اكله حلوة ومشروبات كتير
examples.english: And I will think about a nice meal and many drinks.
examples.transliteration: Wa hafakkar fi akla Helwa w mashroubaat keteer.

examples.arabic: عملت اكلة خفيفة وشربت مشروب سخن بسرعة
examples.english: I made a light meal and drank a hot drink quickly.
examples.transliteration: ʿAmalt akla khafeefa we sheribt mashroub sokhn be-sorʿa.

examples.arabic: دي فرصة حلوة اعمل اكلة لذيذة واقضي وقت هادي في البيت
examples.english: This is a nice chance to make a delicious meal and spend quiet time at home.
examples.transliteration: Di forsa helwa a'mel akla laziza w aqDi waqt hadi fi el beit
